expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Compares center and radius within a tolerance. Reports whether this sphere lies inside the other sphere within tolerance. Returns volume in cubic coordinate units.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: bool bEqual = Sphere.Equals(const FSphere3f& Other, float32 Tolerance = KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER) const; | bool bInside = Sphere.IsInside(const FSphere3f& Other, float32 Tolerance = KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER) const; | float32 Volume = Sphere.GetVolume() const;
